summary: Tests-only red phase for issue #5 (generated OpenAPI Swift client). Two permanent test files and the vendoring/wiring contract doc were added and then reconciled onto the unified contract introduced by sibling commit 5bc09d3 (module ColorMatchingOpenAPI, defensive naming, listRecentSheets). Every acceptance criterion that depends on implementation is intentionally red (missing vendored spec artifact, missing ColorMatchingOpenAPI target) and the failures demonstrate the missing behavior per the phase rules. swift test could not be executed in this container: no Swift toolchain is installed (swift/swiftc not found); CI (macos-latest) runs it. The spec-test logic was validated by simulating all assertions against a synthetic vendored openapi.json matching docs/openapi-generated-client.md (all passed), and all stub JSON literals were verified to parse.
blocked_notes: No Swift toolchain in this container (swift/swiftc absent), so swift test --disable-sandbox could not be run here; the suite compiles without new package dependencies today because the generated-client tests are canImport-guarded and the vendored-spec tests use Foundation only.

Upstream dependency viamin/color_matching#110 verified complete: spec served at GET /api/v1/openapi.json (upstream PR #113, inspected at SHA 14320c33f93258a331cf17af7323ce9035c8a44d); deltas and gaps recorded in docs/openapi-generated-client.md.
